title: ReportRequest
description: Envelope for POST /api/reports. Exactly two fields: 'type' (a closed enum from ReportType) and 'data' (a typed payload whose schema is selected by 'type'). MVP scope: only the 'Period' report type has a defined payload DTO; 'IsoWeek' is a documented future enum value whose payload schema (IsoWeekReportData) will be added together with its strategy in a later feature.

type.description: ReportType enum value. Period is the only fully-defined value in this feature; IsoWeek is reserved for a future feature and its payload shape is intentionally not constrained here.

data.description: Per-type payload. See the if/then branch below for the Period schema. IsoWeek payload (data.week) is documented in the README and will be schema-defined when the IsoWeek strategy ships.

start.description: Inclusive lower bound, calendar date (yyyy-MM-dd). The strategy interprets the period as [start 00:00:00, end 23:59:59] against transaction timestamps.
